name: Danger!! Death All Around You
source:
What if your grim reaper suddenly appeared in front of you and said he wanted to kill you?

Luckily, he may not be able to kill you yet.

Now, now, don't worry~

You are going to make a deal with him and choose your own fate!

Are you capable enough to survive from too many death flags around you?

If you succeed in avoiding all attempts of the grim reaper to kill you, then you can go back to your peaceful life!

And maybe...a little bit of romance with him won't hurt, right?

[From [url=https://dhidhiand.itch.io/danger-death-all-around-you]Itch.io[/url]]
